body.p: Kammungan, who lived at Kingawa, was unable to walk on his feet; but he could run very fast on his hands and knees. When the sledge was going at a high rate of speed, he was able to jump off across the traces of the dogs, and back to the sledge again. His beard was very long. One summer the people who were staying at Issertuqdjuaq, caribou-hunting, were very unsuccessful because the caribou always took the scent of the hunters, and made their escape. Kammungan, however, ran so fast that he headed off the caribou, and killed them. In the fall he came back with his caribou-skins. One day he said, "Why is it that these men, whose legs are perfect, have so few caribou-skins, and I, who am lame, have so many more than they?" Then these men became angry, and wished to kill him. One day they stood ready with their bows and arrows to kill him; but when they were shooting at him, he jumped up, and dodged the arrows. They were unable to hit him. The men then went away, being afraid of his great powers.
